title: D-024 unit O: broker answer paths must resolve their queued_asks rows + recovery-probe read-time reconciliation (restart-blocking defect from the first live limited-auto run)
objective: PROPOSED bounded control-plane correction (Amendment 11 R270; owner approval required before claim). ROOT CAUSE (primary evidence, first live run run_M0_T107_unitJ): ApprovalBroker.deny_request and approve_once mark the approval record answered but never resolve the linked queued_asks row ask_<request_id> - the exact omission M0-T070 fixed in revoke_all only; revoke_all cannot clear DENIED records; recovery_probes.probe_pending_requests reads raw journal.open_asks() WITHOUT the M0-T070 read-time broker-reconciliation the status command applies (cli.py ~1487). NET EFFECT: after an owner deny, S11.5 revalidation fails pending_requests forever and the certified deny->clear-recovery->restart path is permanently blocked (observed live: restart refused UNSAFE_OR_DRIFTED, 0 provider calls, exit 11). FIX (root-cause, H2 RepairRecord 8-predicate gate): (1) deny_request and approve_once resolve their ask_<request_id> row exactly as revoke_all does (answered history, never deleted); (2) probe_pending_requests applies the M0-T070 read-time reconciliation (broker-origin ask whose approval record is resolved is NOT an open owner question) so journals written BEFORE this fix - including the live one with 3 denied-but-unanswered rows - become truthful WITHOUT hand-editing any runtime journal; (3) regression tests that fail if either fix is removed (deny leaves ask row resolved; probe passes on reconciled pre-fix journal shape; probe still FAILS on a genuinely unanswered non-broker ask). CONSEQUENCE (R271): this is a supervisor-source change - it invalidates the R247 golden certification; the full re-certification cycle (M0-T112 pattern: golden pack + affected packs + whole suite + CI at the new frozen identity + activation-package items 10-12 refresh) MUST run before autonomous operation resumes. Owner may optionally schedule M0-T114 (residuals) into the same window to avoid a second recert cycle - owner decision, not bundled by default (corrections stay separate). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R270.
